quote: Integrity and ethics concerns and questions about these policies can be submitted to Wiley's Research Integrity Team using this form
fetch_note: hindawi.com and www.hindawi.com both return HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare bot-challenge page ('cf-mitigated: challenge') under both curl and the fetch tool, so the imprint's own former site cannot be read directly. Response headers for www.hindawi.com (HTTP 103 Early Hints) show it is served from the same 'products/acropolis/pericles' platform infrastructure used by wileyonlinelibrary.com, and web search confirms former Hindawi journals (e.g. Journal of Applied Mathematics, ISSN 1687-0042) now resolve to onlinelibrary.wiley.com. The Wiley research-integrity contact form itself was fetched directly and verified (200).
evidence_note: The Hindawi brand/imprint was retired by Wiley in 2023-2024 after a mass-retraction crisis; its surviving journals were folded into the Wiley Online Library platform (confirmed via web search of secondary sources, e.g. Retraction Watch and Wikipedia's 'Hindawi (publisher)' article), and the working route for raising a concern about a formerly-Hindawi article is now Wiley's own Research Integrity Team form. hindawi.com itself is not independently reachable to confirm this from the imprint's own domain due to the Cloudflare challenge.
